paite: Huai thil nung in Judate ankuangluina a-om a; Jerusalem ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
heading: Bethesda A Hihdamna
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

paite: Jerusalem ah belam kongkhak kiang ah dil khat a-om a, huai mun Hebru pau in Bethesda achi ua, inlim nga anei hi.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

paite: Huai ah tui hong tat ngak in damloute, mittawte, khebaite, zawte tampi alum phengphung uhi.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

paite: Bang hun hiam in huai dil ah angel ahohsuk a, tui ava tok zel a; kuapeuh huai tui kitoh khit a va lut masa penpen in, bangchibang natna nei hileh leng hihdam in a-om zel hi.
english: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

paite: Huai ah kum sawmthum-le-giat damlou mi kuahiam a-om hi.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

paite: Jesu'n huai a lum amu a, huchibang in sawtpi ana omta chih athei a, akiang ah, "Hihdam na ut hia?" achi hi.
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

paite: Damloupa'n, “Pu, tui kitoh in dil a hon koih ding mi ka nei kei a, ka kuan sung in midang in hon makhelh nak uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

paite: Thakhat in huai mipa adam pah a, a-awngphah la in, apaita hi.
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

paite: Huai ni Sabbath ni ahi a, Judate'n adampa kiang ah, "Sabbath ni ei ve, na awngphah na lak asiang kei," achi uhi.
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon hihdampa ngeingei in ka kiang ah, 'Na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in,' hon chi ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in, na kiang a chipa kua ahia?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

paite: Himahleh adampa'n kua ahia ahih athei kei, huai a mipi a-om ziak un Jesu apaimangta hi.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

paite: Aden chiang in Jesu'n amah tempul ah amu a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na damta hi, khial nawn ke'n, huchi lou in zaw thil hoih lou sem na tung ah ahong tung kha ding," achi hi.
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

paite: Huan huai mi ava paikhia a, Judate kiang ah, "Ahihdampa Jesu ahi," chih ahilh hi.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

paite: Huchi in Sabbath ni a athilhih ziak in Judate'n Jesu a-engbawl ua, thah ding in azong uhi.
heading: Khrist, Tapa Tungtawn A Hinna
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Ka Pa'n tu tanpha in nna asem zel a, ke'n leng ka sem zel," achi hi.
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

paite: Huchi in Judate'n hihlup atum semsem ua, Sabbath ni atan louh ziak kia ahi kei, Pathian amah Pa a abawl leh Pathian toh kikim a akibawl ziak in leng ahi.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, “Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Tapa in amah in bangmah ahihthei kei, Pa thilhih amuh kia lou ngal; thil ahih peuhmah, Tapa in leng ahih sam zel hi.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

paite: Pa in Tapa a-it a, athilhih peuhmah akiang ah amusak a; hiaite sang a thilhih thupizaw akiang ah amusak lai ding, lamdang na sak ding un.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

paite: Pa in misite kaithou a, hinna apiak bang in, Tapa in leng a-utna peuh kiang ah hinna apia hi.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

paite: Pa in kuamah vai ahawmsak ngei kei, himahleh vai tengteng Tapa in ahawmsak zaw hi;
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

paite: mi tengteng in Pa zahna apiak bang un, Tapa leng zahna apiakna ding un. Kuapeuh Tapa zahloute'n, Pa asawlpa leng azah kei uhi.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

paite: "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh ka thu za a, hon sawlpa gingta in, tangtawn hinna anei; siam louh in a-om kei a, sihna a kipan apawt a, hinna ah alut zawta hi.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ahun atung dekta, tu in leng atung lellel, huai hun chiang in misite'n Pathian Tapa aw aza ding ua, aza peuhmah ahing ding uh.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

paite: Pa in amah a hinna aneih bang in, Tapa in leng amah a hinna nei ding in apeta hi.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

paite: Mihing Tapa ahih ziak in, akiang ah thukhenna leh thuneihna apia hi.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

paite: Hiai lamdang sa kei un, ahun atungta, huai hun chiang in han a om tengteng in a-aw aza ding ua,
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

paite: ahong pawt vek ding uh; thil hoih hihte hinna tang in athounawn ding ua, thil gilou hihte siam louh tang in athounawn ding uhi.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

paite: "Keimah in bangmah ka hihthei kei; bil a ka zak bangbang in vai ka hawm zel; ka vaihawm adik ahi, keimah deihlam a om ka tum kei; hon sawlpa deihlam a om ka tup zel ziak in.
heading: Johan Theihpihna
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

paite: "Keimah tanchin theihpihtu a pang hi leng, ka thu theihpihna adik kei ding hi.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

paite: Ka tanchin toh kisai theihpihtu midang khat a-om, ama'n ka tanchin atheihpihna apiak pen dik ahi, chih ka thei hi.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

paite: Nou Johan kiang ah mi na sawl ua, ama'n thutak thu ahon theihpih hi.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

paite: Thu theihpihna ka san mihing a kipan ahi kei a; himahleh na hinna ding un hiai thu ka gen ahi.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

paite: Huai Johan khawnvak kuangtak leh vaktak ahi, avak ah nopsak takdih na ut uhi.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

paite: "Himahleh theihpihna ka neih zaw Johan theihpihna sang in athupizaw hi; Pa'n thilhih zoh ding a ahon piak, ka thilhih ngei in Pa'n hon sawl chih ka tanchin atheisak hi.
heading: Jesu Nasep Theihpihna
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

paite: "Pa hon sawlpa ngei leng ka tanchin atheihpihtu in apang hi. Nou chik lai mah in a-aw na za ngei kei ua, amel leng na mu ngei kei uh.
heading: Pa Theihpihna
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

paite: Athu leng noumau ah na tengsak kei uh, asawl mipa na gintak louh ziak uh ahi.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

paite: "Laisiangthou sung a tangtawn hinna om ding a na ngaihtuah ziak un na nak zon ngial ua; huaite mah ka tanchin theihpihtute ahi uhi.
heading: Laisiangthou Theihpihna
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

paite: Himahleh hinna nei ding in ka kiang ah na hong nuam kei uhi.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

paite: "Mihing pahtawina ka sang kei.
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

paite: Himahleh nou ka hon thei hi, Pathian itna noumau ah na nei kei uhi.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

paite: Ka Pa min in ka hong a, noute'n na hon kipahpih kei uh; midang ama min in hong taleh amah na na kipahpih ding uhi.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

paite: Nou kipahtawi tuahna paktate'n Pathian tak kia a pawt pahtawina zong lou in bangchi in kei na hon gingta thei ding ua?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

paite: Ke'n Pa kiang a nou ka hon hek ding gingta kei un; nou hon hek khat a-om, na muan uh Mosi ngei.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

paite: Mosi gingta hi le uchin, kei leng na hon gingtata ding uh; ka tanchin gelh lah amah ahi ngal a.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

paite: Himahleh ama thugelh gingta lou in, bangchi in ka thute na gingta ding ua?" achi hi.
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
